name: Orlám

died at the hand of Cúchulainn on the cattle raid
killed Orlám and brained his charioteer

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Orlám is an Irish hero. Orlám was a son of king Ailill mac Máta and queen Medb, the rulers of Connacht in the west of Ireland. During the cattle raid called the Táin Bó Cuailnge, Cúchulainn cut Orlám down among the raid’s first casualties. His charioteer carried his master's head to Medb and Ailill. For that act the charioteer was brained by a stone thrown by Cúchulainn.

okr.objective: Orlám is a Connacht hero slain by Cúchulainn.
